predecessors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
predecessors.text: the Alt Urgell core: La Seu d'Urgell, the Valira valleys of Andorra, Organyà and Oliana (13 cells)

successors.name: Crown of Aragon
successors.text: the county's land as the counts held it in 1413 (the 1236 keyframe, 17 cells): 'The county of Urgell was extinguished and absorbed by the Crown of Aragon in 1413'

ledger.x: 798: the county of Urgell begins under its first count, Borrell.
June 870: Charles the Bald gives Wilfred the Hairy Urgell and Cerdanya.
11 August 897: Wilfred dies and Miró takes Cerdanya.
948: Borrell II of Barcelona inherits Urgell.
992: Urgell separates from Barcelona under Ermengol I.
1050: Ermengol III takes Camarasa and Cubells.
1076: Ermengol IV begins a Reconquista of his own.
1091: Ermengol IV takes Linyola and Belcaire.
1105: Ermengol VI conquers Balaguer and makes it his capital.
1105: the seat moves from La Seu d'Urgell to Balaguer.
1133: Ermengol VI cedes Andorra to the Bishop of Urgell.
1231: the county passes to James I of Aragon.
1236: James I recognises Ponç IV of Cabrera as count.
1236: the county returns to the counts of Urgell under the Crown.
1236: Ponç IV of Cabrera holds the county as the Crown's fief.
1413: the counts' fief ends with the extinction of the county.
1413: the Crown of Aragon absorbs the County of Urgell.
1413: the county is absorbed by the Crown of Aragon.

wars.name: Barbastro War of 1064
wars.outcome: Ermengol III 'took part in the Barbastro War of 1064 under the banner of his brother-in-law Sancho Ramírez of Aragon'; the page gives no land for Urgell.

wars.name: Ermengol IV's Reconquista in the Sió basin
wars.outcome: Ermengol IV took the Sió basin with Agramunt and Almenar in 1076 and Linyola and Belcaire in 1091.

wars.name: Conquest of Balaguer (1105)
wars.outcome: Ermengol VI conquered Balaguer in 1105 (the Balaguer page: 1106) and made it his capital.

wars.name: Siege of Zaragoza (1118)
wars.outcome: 'Ermengol collaborated with Alfonso the Battler in the 1118 capture of Zaragoza'; no Urgell border moved.

wars.name: Conquest of Lleida (1149)
wars.outcome: Lleida fell in 1149; Ermengol VI received one third of the city.

wars.name: Conquest of Almería (1147)
wars.outcome: Ermengol VI was 'against Almería in 1147' (and a commander at Albacete in 1146); no Urgell border moved.

wars.name: Guerau IV of Cabrera's seizure of Urgell
wars.outcome: After Peter II of Aragon's death (1213) Guerau IV of Cabrera, Aurembiaix's cousin, 'invaded the county and took control'; in 1228 she returned, in 1229 she rendered Lleida to James I and took Urgell back as his fief.

certainty.note: A Pyrenean county: the pages name valleys, towns and comarques, never a boundary line; the outlines are Cliopatria's stand-ins.
